title: The Watch job is called Dashboard

statements.says: Studio's first job and the page that does it are both called Dashboard, no longer Watch.
Watch becomes the word to avoid in the glossary, in place of Dashboard.
The Watch Slice becomes Dashboard in every project, in the namespaces, in the slices list and in the front end.
The older redirect that sent pre-address links on to Watch is deleted.
Earlier records that call Studio the dashboard or name the Watch Slice are history and stay as they were written.
Everyone knows what to expect from a page called Dashboard, and nobody knows what to expect from one called Watch.
The name reaches the code as well as the screen because the code speaks the glossary.
Nobody uses Studio yet, so no bookmark needs keeping.

Renaming the page while keeping the job called Watch was rejected, because the Slices would stay Watch while the screen said Dashboard, so the code would use a word the glossary no longer holds for that thing.
